articles.title: Barnwell makes sense of a blowout-filled Week 8: One key takeaway from each of Sunday's 11 games
articles.summary: Ten of Sunday's 11 games were two-score wins -- not super exciting. But we still found something fun in every matchup, including some RB takeovers.

articles.title: What you need to know from Week 8: Jordan Love, Packers defeat Rodgers
articles.summary: Our NFL Nation reporters answer the biggest questions out of each game. Here's what we learned from Week 8.

articles.title: Bills fear DT Oliver has torn biceps, sources say
articles.summary: The Bills fear that standout defensive tackle Ed Oliver tore a biceps in Sunday's 40-9 victory over the Panthers and will be sidelined indefinitely, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Source: Lockett to reunite with Carroll on Raiders
articles.summary: Veteran wide receiver Tyler Lockett, who was released by the Titans last week, is expected to sign with the Las Vegas Raiders, sources confirmed to ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Browns' top tackler has high ankle sprain
articles.summary: Tests confirmed Browns rookie linebacker Carson Schwesinger suffered a high ankle sprain in Sunday's loss, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

articles.title: Love outduels Rodgers as Pack tout 'the successor'
articles.summary: With former Green Bay quarterback Aaron Rodgers watching from the sidelines, Jordan Love showed just how much he learned from his predecessor en route to the Packers' impressive 35-25 victory over the Steelers on Sunday night in Pittsburgh.

articles.title: Giants 'devastated' after Skattebo dislocates ankle
articles.summary: Giants rookie running back Cam Skattebo was carted off the field Sunday because of a gruesome right ankle injury.

articles.title: Harbaugh: Lamar practice miscue 'honest mistake'
articles.summary: Coach John Harbaugh called the Ravens' violation of the NFL's injury report policy regarding Lamar Jackson "an honest mistake."

articles.title: Jerry skeptical Dallas is '1 player away on defense'
articles.summary: Following the Cowboys' blowout loss to the Broncos on Sunday, owner and GM Jerry Jones indicated he is willing to engage on a trade but isn't convinced the team's defense is "one player away" from being competitive.

articles.title: 'Witnessing greatness': Colts' Taylor stars again
articles.summary: Jonathan Taylor ran for 153 yards, including an 80-yard TD, in a 38-14 win over the Titans on Sunday. "We're witnessing greatness right in front of us," DeForest Buckner said.

articles.title: 👀 Overreactions: More Fields? Garrett DPOY?
articles.summary: We sized up Week 8 overreactions -- including for fantasy football. Is Fields on more solid ground? Will Garrett be the DPOY? Do the 49ers need defensive help?

articles.title: 'Monday Night Football' moments for all 32 NFL teams, including one we'd rather forget
articles.summary: Dazzling plays, huge comebacks and one notable injury punctuated the first 55 years of 'Monday Night Football.'

articles.title: 'Everybody gotta eat': With Rice back, Chiefs finally have offense they envisioned
articles.summary: The offense the Chiefs constructed in 2024 finally became a reality with Rashee Rice's return last week.

articles.title: Why a team that was one win from a Super Bowl is wallowing in third place in NFC East
articles.summary: With Jayden Daniels set to miss his third game on Monday night, Washington is off to an unexpectedly slow start.

articles.title: 'Our identity right now is inconsistent': Where will 3-4-1 Cowboys go from here?
articles.summary: Dallas hasn't won back-to-back games since last season and faces a tough schedule the next two months.

articles.title: Buzz: Who got the ball, who got shut out on Sunday
articles.summary: Knowing who got the ball and how is as important as the fantasy points that were (and weren't) put up on Sunday.

articles.title: Winners and losers: Taylor, Cook deliver; CMC, Robinson fall flat
articles.summary: Jonathan Taylor, James Cook III and Saquon Barkley led the way with big Week 8 performances.

articles.title: Eagles get revenge on Giants with petty post, topping NFL Week 8 trolls
articles.summary: The NFL remained petty in Week 8, even though it had its fair share of blowouts and close victories.

articles.summary: Week 8's arrivals mixed personal flair and cold. weather layers with comfort and creativity.
